info.title: VitalSense API
info.description: VitalSense Personal Health and Wellness Platform API. Modular monolith co-deploying Web and Mobile boundaries.

get.description: Lightweight liveness check confirming the HTTP process is serving requests.
Readiness check verifying backend connectivity to authoritative PostgreSQL.

post.description: Register a new user account via Web client, issuing auth cookies without exposing tokens in JSON body (OD-18).
Authenticate email and password, setting HttpOnly cookies without exposing tokens in JSON body (OD-18).
Rotate refresh token from cookie or body, rotating cookies without exposing tokens in JSON body (OD-18).
Revoke session family and clear auth cookies.

get.description: Retrieve authenticated user account and primary person profile information.
List all active session families across user devices.

post.description: Revoke a specific session family by UUID.
Initiate password reset process, issuing a single-use expiring token.
Reset account password using the token, revoking all active sessions.
Execute batch synchronization for the web client (IndexedDB offline cache).

post.summary: Safe Full Resynchronization for Web Client
post.description: Reset cursor and retrieve baseline records while preserving un-synced web drafts.

get.description: Verify web-facing client boundary is operational.

post.description: Register a new user account from a mobile/native client, returning JWT and rotating refresh token.
Authenticate mobile user and establish a persistent device session family.
Rotate the refresh token for a mobile device. Detects token reuse and revokes compromised families.
Revoke the session family associated with the presented refresh token.

get.description: Retrieve authenticated user and person details.
List all registered device sessions for the authenticated user.

post.description: Revoke a specific session family across all rotated tokens.
Initiate password reset process, issuing a single-use expiring token.
Reset account password using the token, revoking all active sessions.

post.summary: Batch Synchronize Mobile Client Observations and Deletions
post.description:
Execute batch synchronization for mobile and native clients (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS).

Ingests new health observations, applies corrections, propagates tombstones, and returns server deltas.
Returns HTTP 409 SYNC_CURSOR_EXPIRED if the client has been offline for >30 days.

post.summary: Safe Full Resynchronization Preserving Offline Drafts
post.description:
Execute safe full resynchronization following cursor expiration.

Forces last_sync_timestamp to None to retrieve canonical server baseline,
while ingesting pending local offline changes and drafts.

get.description: Verify mobile-facing client boundary is operational.

last_sync_timestamp.title: Last Sync Timestamp
last_sync_timestamp.description: Latest sync timestamp acknowledged by client device. None for initial sync.

observations.title: Observations
observations.description: Batch of health observations captured or corrected offline. Maximum batch size is 500.

tombstones.title: Tombstones
tombstones.description: Deletions performed locally on the client to propagate upstream. Maximum batch size is 500.

BatchSyncRequest.title: BatchSyncRequest
BatchSyncRequest.description: Batch payload submitted by client devices (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Web).

processed_count.title: Processed Count
processed_count.description: Number of newly inserted or corrected observations.

duplicate_count.title: Duplicate Count
duplicate_count.description: Number of idempotent duplicate records safely skipped.

next_sync_cursor.title: Next Sync Cursor
next_sync_cursor.description: Authoritative sync cursor timestamp to persist on the client device.

server_observations.title: Server Observations
server_observations.description: Health observations created or modified on other devices since last_sync_timestamp.

server_tombstones.title: Server Tombstones
server_tombstones.description: Deletions committed on the server that must be pruned from client local SQLite storage.

BatchSyncResponse.title: BatchSyncResponse
BatchSyncResponse.description: Synchronization outcome containing upstream deltas, tombstones, and updated cursor.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the probe response.

LivenessResponse.title: LivenessResponse
LivenessResponse.description: Payload for the lightweight /health liveness probe.

ObservationDTO.title: ObservationDTO
ObservationDTO.description: Server-side health observation record dispatched to client devices.

metric_name.title: Metric Name
metric_name.description: Metric category identifier. Must be one of the approved Phase 1 metrics.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Measurement unit corresponding to the metric definition.

measured_at.title: Measured At
measured_at.description: Authoritative UTC timestamp when the measurement took place. Preserved during corrections.

end_timestamp.title: End Timestamp
end_timestamp.description: End UTC timestamp for duration metrics (e.g. workout_session, sleep_session).

source_timezone.title: Source Timezone
source_timezone.description: Timezone string where the measurement was recorded (e.g. 'America/New_York').

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Provenance of the observation. Controlled manual entries must use 'user_entered'.

supersedes_record_id.title: Supersedes Record Id
supersedes_record_id.description: If correcting an existing record, the UUID of the record being superseded.

device_record_id.title: Device Record Id
device_record_id.description: Client device's local record UUID or primary key.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Unique idempotency key ensuring deduplication across repeated sync attempts.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Extensible metadata payload (e.g. workout type, sleep stage breakdown).

ObservationItem.title: ObservationItem
ObservationItem.description: Client observation submission payload item for batch ingestion.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: New plaintext password meeting complexity criteria.

PasswordResetConfirmRequest.title: PasswordResetConfirmRequest
PasswordResetConfirmRequest.description: Payload to confirm password reset with token.

PasswordResetRequest.title: PasswordResetRequest
PasswordResetRequest.description: Payload to request password reset token.

message.title: Message
message.description: Status message regarding the password reset process.

reset_token.title: Reset Token
reset_token.description: In development or testing environments, the generated reset token for verification.

PasswordResetResponse.title: PasswordResetResponse
PasswordResetResponse.description: Response returned upon password reset request.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the probe response.

ReadinessResponse.title: ReadinessResponse
ReadinessResponse.description: Payload for the /ready readiness probe evaluating dependency availability.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Plaintext refresh token received from previous login/refresh.

RefreshTokenRequest.title: RefreshTokenRequest
RefreshTokenRequest.description: Payload for rotating refresh token exchange.

password.title: Password
password.description: Plaintext password meeting complexity criteria (minimum 8 characters).

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: Unique device identifier registering the account.

family_id.title: Family Id
family_id.description: Session family UUID to revoke across all rotated tokens.

RevokeSessionRequest.title: RevokeSessionRequest
RevokeSessionRequest.description: Payload to revoke a specific session family.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Timestamp when the session family was established.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp of the latest active refresh token in the family.

is_active.title: Is Active
is_active.description: Whether the session family contains valid, unrevoked tokens.

SessionItem.title: SessionItem
SessionItem.description: Representation of an active or historical device session family.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Signed HMAC-SHA256 JWT access token (15-minute expiration).

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Rotating cryptographically secure 32-byte URL-safe refresh token.

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Access token lifetime in seconds (e.g. 900 for 15 minutes).

TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
TokenResponse.description: Payload returned upon successful authentication or token refresh.

TombstoneDTO.title: TombstoneDTO
TombstoneDTO.description: Server-side tombstone dispatched to clients to purge local cache.

target_record_id.title: Target Record Id
target_record_id.description: UUID of the health record being deleted.

deleted_at.title: Deleted At
deleted_at.description: UTC timestamp of the deletion action.

device_record_id.title: Device Record Id
device_record_id.description: Optional local client device record ID corresponding to the deleted record.

TombstoneItem.title: TombstoneItem
TombstoneItem.description: Client-submitted deletion tombstone to propagate to canonical server.

UserProfileResponse.title: UserProfileResponse
UserProfileResponse.description: User profile response returning account and person metadata.

WebAuthResponse.title: WebAuthResponse
WebAuthResponse.description:
Payload returned upon successful Web authentication or token refresh.

Implements OD-18: Access and refresh tokens are delivered exclusively via
secure HttpOnly cookies and are strictly omitted from the JSON response body.
